questiontext.text: What is a food contaminant?

generalfeedback.text: Contaminants are unwanted foreign substances that render food impure or dangerous to health.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Contaminants are unwanted foreign substances that render food impure or dangerous to health.

answer.text: Any harmful biological, chemical, or physical substance introduced into food that makes it unsafe for human consumption

feedback.text: Incorrect. Cross-contamination transfers pathogens from raw items to cooked or fresh foods.

feedback.text: Correct! Cross-contamination transfers pathogens from raw items to cooked or fresh foods.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Cross-contamination transfers pathogens from raw items to cooked or fresh foods.
